title: Home - Friends of Karura Forest

facts.fact: Friends of Karura Forest is a community forest association involved in joint forest management.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: Community Forest Association founded in 2009. It jointly manages the forest

facts.fact: The forest offers walking, running, cycling on designated trails, waterfalls and caves.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: Stroll, run, cycle and explore waterfalls and caves

facts.fact: The promoted marked walking loops are 5km yellow, 10km blue and 15km green.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: The trails are colour-coded: 5 km (yellow), 10 km (blue), and 15 km (green).
